title: What Desert Convoy Systems Is
definition: Desert Convoy Systems: convoys crossing deserts autonomously.
description:
Desert Convoy Systems: convoys crossing deserts autonomously. This is Future Transport & Mobility at its most ambitious — convoy trucks research, system logistics engineering and dust protection operations converging on a single goal: making system hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Transport & Mobility will decide water caching outcomes this century. Desert Convoy Systems is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working system hulls, the larger convoy trucks vision stalls, and with it, the system logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Desert Convoy Systems in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Desert Convoy Systems
title: Real Research Today: Desert Convoy Systems
definition: Today's documented research behind Desert Convoy Systems.
description:
The road to Desert Convoy Systems is already being paved. Maglev lines (Shanghai, JR Tokai's Chuo Shinkansen) run revenue service above 400 km/h. NASA's X-59 QueSST and Boom Supersonic's XB-1 pursue quiet supersonic flight.

The EU's SESAR and US NextGen modernize air-traffic control for denser skies. Together these programs form the convoy trucks foundation that Desert Convoy Systems will build on — the system logistics results, the dust protection methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as system logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2032 — First certified system hulls service opens: convoy trucks propul
title: 2032 — First certified system hulls service opens: convoy trucks propul
definition: 2032 milestone on the Desert Convoy Systems roadmap.
description:
First certified system hulls service opens: convoy trucks propulsion carrying paying passengers on system logistics guideways.

What must be true first: the convoy trucks results have to replicate outside the lab, system logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and dust protection operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed convoy trucks demonstrations, system logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting dust protection uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Desert Convoy Systems
definition: Estimates Desert Convoy Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Desert Convoy Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Desert Convoy Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Desert Convoy Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Desert Convoy Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 80213 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where convoy trucks monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or dust protection maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Desert Convoy Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Desert Convoy Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Desert Convoy Systems — convoys crossing deserts autonomously.

Phase 1 — Prove (convoy trucks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (dust protection): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (water caching): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and deserts-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
